roleHints.owner: Everything, including billing and deleting the workspace
roleHints.admin: Manages people, roles, templates and connectors
roleHints.billing: Manages the plan, the invoices and the payment method, nothing else
roleHints.organizer: A member who also creates meetings when they're kept to admins, and invites the people they need
